zero_fabrication_disclosure: All metrics in this report are computed dynamically from out-of-fold GroupKFold and chronological TimeSeriesSplit cross-validation on the labeled dataset.
metric_interpretation_caveat: When the input is the built-in SIMULATED demo stream, stress labels are generated by a deterministic rule from the same physiological channels used as features, so near-perfect scores (e.g., F1 = 1.0) reflect label separability of the synthetic generator, NOT real-world astronaut stress-detection accuracy. Only metrics computed on real MMASH/WESAD files are scientifically meaningful.

health_state_classification.scientific_justification: Supported for acute autonomic stress vs. baseline state classification using HR, HRV (RMSSD, SDNN), electrodermal activity (EDA), skin temperature, and actigraphy features. NOT supported on NASA OSDR OSD-575/569 directly because N=4 astronauts is too small for supervised classification without overfitting.
health_state_classification.limitations_and_guardrails: Random row splitting causes severe subject-identity leakage (>95% artificial accuracy). GroupKFold by subject_id is mandatory.

physiological_trend_forecasting.scientific_justification: Short-horizon (5-to-60 min ahead) HR and HRV RMSSD forecasting is well-supported by lagged autoregressive physiological and activity features. Multi-month (180-900 day) BMD/radiation trends cannot use pure ML extrapolation and require coupling with mechanistic ODE priors.
physiological_trend_forecasting.limitations_and_guardrails: MAPE is appropriate for positive bounded targets (HR bpm, RMSSD ms), but must NEVER be used on zero-crossing Z-scores or % BMD deltas where denominators approach 0.

sleep_and_activity_analysis.scientific_justification: Supported for predicting sleep efficiency, Wake After Sleep Onset (WASO), and Borbely homeostatic sleep pressure from daytime actigraphy (ENMO), autonomic sympathovagal ratio, and circadian phase alignment.
sleep_and_activity_analysis.limitations_and_guardrails: Terrestrial 1g sleep architecture serves as a baseline prior; microgravity circadian phase drift is incorporated as an explicit environmental offset.

workload_and_recovery_analysis.task_name: 4. Physical Workload & Post-Exertion Autonomic Recovery Analysis
workload_and_recovery_analysis.scientific_justification: Supported by modeling the autonomic recovery rate (RMSSD rebound and HR decay slope) following high-ENMO physical workload windows and ARED/LBNP sessions.
workload_and_recovery_analysis.limitations_and_guardrails: Requires lag interaction features between cumulative physical activity (ENMO) and subsequent vagal recovery (RMSSD).

anomaly_detection.task_name: 5. Multivariate Physiological & Habitat Telemetry Anomaly Detection
anomaly_detection.splitting_strategy: Fit strictly on Nominal Baseline Windows -> Evaluate on Holdout + Anomalies
anomaly_detection.scientific_justification: Highly supported via unsupervised/semi-supervised IsolationForest trained on nominal crew baseline physiology to flag out-of-distribution tachycardic, hypercapnic, or acute stress excursions.
anomaly_detection.limitations_and_guardrails: Contamination hyperparameter must be calibrated on clean baseline data to prevent alarm fatigue for Flight Surgeons.

model_selection_rationale.xgboost_and_deep_learning_justification: XGBoost installed=False. Scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting and RandomForest/LogisticRegression achieve strong out-of-subject generalization without overfitting small-N biomedical cohorts, whereas deep neural networks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) overfit small subject cohorts (N=4 to 24).
